results.title: Torsion-sensitive tensor order reduction
results.question: Construct polynomial-size d-to-3 TI reductions over arbitrary commutative rings that preserve exact isomorphism on nonfree input modules and recover transporters.
results.result: Reduce arbitrary-order dense presented tensors over a fixed finite commutative ring to free three-tensors and recover transporters.

results.title: Hybrid compact and general-linear tensor actions
results.question: Determine the worst-case complexity of 3-tensor equivalence under O(a) x GL(b) x GL(c) on rational inputs, preserving the distinction between real and rational witnesses.
results.result: For both rational and real witnesses, sandwich hybrid orthogonal TI between bipartite graph isomorphism and same-field ordinary TI.

results.title: Tractability-versus-completeness dichotomy for TOCI
results.question: For fixed-format signatures producing families of tensor tuples with varying dimensions, prove that each corresponding OCI problem is in polynomial time or TOCI-complete, or give a natural intermediate counterexample under explicit assumptions.
results.result: Classify fixed pure mixed signatures and tuples of individually balanced signatures for products of general linear groups.

results.title: Pure mixed quartic TOCI completeness
results.question: Is OCI for GL(V) acting diagonally on V^{⊗2}⊗(V*)^{⊗2} complete for TOCI under the reductions of Lysikov–Walter?
results.result: Orbit-closure intersection for a single mixed quartic is TOCI-complete by an affine-linear embedding on three copies of the input space.

results.title: Symmetric-tensor TOCI completeness
results.question: Does a natural orbit-closure-intersection problem for symmetric tensors give a TOCI-complete problem?
results.result: Orbit-closure intersection for one degree-15 symmetric form under the complex orthogonal group is TOCI-complete.

results.title: Special-unitary tensor orbit decision
results.question: Classify exact 3-tensor equivalence under SU rather than U over finite fields, including determinant obstructions not removable by scalar rescaling.
results.result: Decide finite-field special-unitary transport and count the determinant orbit splitting when the three Hermitian Gram spectra are split and simple.

results.title: Orbit count of inequivalent field representations of one matroid
results.question: For a displayed representable matroid given through its rank function and a fixed finite field, count representations up to row operations, column rescaling and coordinate automorphisms without enumerating all full matrices.
results.result: Count labeled projective representation classes exactly over any finite field when the fundamental support is a cactus.

results.title: Matroid representation rigidity certificate
results.question: For represented matroids over arbitrary finite fields, decide whether every representation over that field is projectively equivalent to the supplied one, or characterize a nontrivial tractable parameter beyond uniquely representable fields.
results.result: Compare displayed matroids in fixed-parameter time in support cycle rank and test labeled projective rigidity with field size as an additional parameter.

results.title: Cayley epimorphism under a one-subgroup mark
results.question: Given G, H and a subgroup L of G, decide whether some epimorphism has kernel intersecting L trivially in polynomial Cayley-table time for unrestricted L.
results.result: Construct a Cayley-table epimorphism injective on an arbitrary marked subgroup for targets that are products of nonabelian simple groups and arbitrary finite abelian groups.

results.title: Identifying minimum degree from an ordinary character table
results.question: For finite p-groups, determine whether the minimum faithful permutation degree is determined by the ordinary character table together with power maps on conjugacy classes.
results.result: Compute the minimum faithful permutation degree of every odd-prime p-group from its ordinary character table with power maps.

results.title: A constant-round counting logic for cyclic groups with arbitrary colors
results.question: Determine whether colored cyclic groups are identified by a constant-dimensional, constant-round version of counting WL, with order and alphabet unbounded.
results.result: One round of group WL Version II suffices for colored cyclic groups, and at sufficiently large fixed width the worst-case round order in Version I is log log n.

results.title: Coset intersection with partial point maps at sublinear cost
results.question: Given a chain of growing partial point identifications between two cosets, maintain feasibility more efficiently than recomputing every prior prefix. Seek guaranteed polynomial update time after one quasipolynomial preprocessing pass.
results.result: Return exact feasibility and a witness under online point-image constraints in polynomial update time after quasipolynomial preprocessing.

results.title: Exact depth lower bounds for quasigroup validity
results.question: Determine tight asymptotic CNF and DNF sizes for the Latin-square property when operation tables are encoded as n² binary labels, both with and without a row-permutation promise.
results.result: Compute the exact DNF size of Latin-square validity and prove a cubic CNF lower bound under a binary row-permutation promise.

results.title: Irreducible multiplicities of secants over small characteristic
results.question: Find a representation-theoretic test for membership among bounded secant Veronese varieties when Schur module filtrations replace direct sums of irreducible representations.
results.result: Test fixed-degree, fixed-rank secant membership for both divided-power Veronese tensors and ordinary powers in positive characteristic.

results.title: Full reduced conormal bound for non-squarefree determinants
results.question: Determine whether the slot-(n−2) conormal multidegree bound survives for the full reduced hypersurface of a determinant pencil whose determinant is not squarefree.
results.result: Extend the ordinary and symmetric conormal bounds to all reduced components of a non-squarefree determinant pencil, weighted by their original multiplicities.

results.title: Sparse rational-function reconstruction
results.question: From black-box values away from poles, reconstruct reduced s-sparse numerator and denominator of fixed individual degree over Q in deterministic time polynomial in n,s and coefficient bits.
results.result: Deterministically reconstruct sparse rational functions of fixed individual degree from an exact oracle that reports poles.

results.title: Noncommutative PIT under succinct evaluation substitutions
results.question: Does the noncommutative ABP hitting construction survive if every input label is itself given by a small-depth noncommutative circuit of degree bounded polynomially, without expanding the resulting circuit into an ABP?
results.result: Run deterministic noncommutative matrix hitting directly on ABPs with product-depth-bounded or log-depth binary DAG labels.

results.title: Circuit-valued powering bases
results.question: Can polynomial-time deterministic powering-circuit PIT replace sparse bases by bounded-width branching-program bases?
results.result: Give deterministic white-box testing for high powers with variable-width ROABP bases and a polynomial-size hitting set for fixed width in one known order.

results.title: Quantitative limits of pp reductions for PC membership
results.question: Determine whether each pp interpretation of fixed dimension with bounded arity admits PC-IMP reductions with additive degree overhead for all input certificate degrees.
results.result: Transfer polynomial calculus refutations through affine primitive-positive decoders with degree at most the maximum of the original degree and a fixed local bound.

results.title: Automorphisms of configuration exponentiation
results.question: Determine Aut(X↑G) explicitly from Aut(X) and the supplied permutation action G, including exceptional enlargement beyond the evident wreath-product action.
results.result: Determine the full automorphism group when Hamming adjacency is recognized from the fused valencies, with strict enlargement examples.

results.title: Recovering exponentiation from algebraic parameters
results.question: Determine whether every configuration algebraically isomorphic to an exponentiation admits an exponentiation representation with the same number of factors.
results.result: For each d≥2 construct an algebraically isomorphic scheme with no exponentiation representation using d factors.

results.title: A sufficient structural test excluding primitive fusions
results.question: Find a broad checkable structural condition ensuring a coherent configuration has no primitive fusion of rank greater than two.
results.result: A cut using at most c basis colors certifies that every primitive fusion has rank at most c+1.

results.title: Sparse collisions and canonical form separations
results.question: For polynomial-time equivalence relations whose classes have at most two members, characterize when a complete invariant can be converted to a canonical form with polynomial-time randomized computation.
results.result: For an explicit two-member relation built from a forward permutation, randomized canonization implies average-case inversion, and efficient worst-case inversion suffices.

results.title: Rationally weighted vertex-deck reconstruction
results.question: Determine whether complete graphs with rational edge weights are reconstructed, up to simultaneous vertex permutation, from their vertex-deleted weighted decks; give a precise theorem or counterexample for all n>=3.
results.result: Reconstruct rationally weighted complete graphs at orders 3 and 4, and at every order when the unique-weight edges have minimum degree at least two.

results.title: Modular separating graph invariants
results.question: Over a fixed finite field whose characteristic divides n!, determine whether polynomial-degree graph invariants with polynomial evaluation cost can still separate every Boolean graph orbit.
results.result: Equate polynomial evaluation of polynomial-degree separating invariants over the fixed base field with a polynomial-time Boolean graph complete invariant.

results.title: Reference-state generation for explicit finite-group actions
results.question: Determine the cost of generating a short family of quantum probes that identifies an unknown state transporter in a given finite-group representation, including exact reconstruction guarantees.
results.result: Construct a single polynomial-bit probe that identifies transporters for an explicit finite group action up to the scalar kernel.
